summary.text: Don Crozier is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 103 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Dave Hinman (R).
Ballotpedia lists his profession as engineer.

paragraphs.text: Don Crozier graduated from Hazelwood Central High School and, according to Ballotpedia, earned a graduate degree from the University of Missouri-St. Louis in 1997.
He was the unopposed Democratic nominee for Missouri State Senate District 2 in 2010, when Republican Scott Rupp won the general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Crozier said he is pro-choice, supports quality public education, and favors strong laws to limit and prosecute corruption.
